description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractFixture' used for managing fixtures in testing within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for obtaining services such as TextHelperService, interacts with Doctrine ORM, and handles YAML output for fixture data.

classes.name: AbstractFixture
classes.description: An abstract class providing common fixture-related functionalities such as retrieving services, dumping fixture data to YAML files, and defining interface methods for subclasses to implement content provision and filename specification.

methods.name: getTextHelperService
methods.description: Returns an instance of TextHelperService, instantiating it if not already created.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine EntityManager used for database interactions.

methods.name: dumpFixture
methods.description: Exports fixture data to a YAML file in the designated fixtures directory after performing validation on the database connection.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide fixture data as an array.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Abstract static method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the filename for the fixture output.
